title: Customer portal is on by default only for Service Advisor, Senior Service Advisor, Service Manager and Parts Manager (and Administrator)
preconds: 1. All 11 system roles are present on the Roles list.
steps:
1. For each of the 11 system roles, open the role editor or Permission Summary.
  2. Find the Customer portal toggle.
  3. Note whether it is on or off by default.
expected:
Customer portal is on by default for Administrator, Service Manager, Senior Service Advisor, Service Advisor and Parts Manager.

It is off by default for Foreman, Technician, Parts Technician, Office User, Sales Representative and Time Clock User.
